maddeler.e:
أتشابه (form VI)
# أَتَشَابَهُ (ʔatašābahu) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ba.hu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# أَتَشَابَهَ (ʔatašābaha) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ba.ha/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
# أَتَشَابَهْ (ʔatašābah) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.bah/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَابَهَ (tašābaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
